✗ Accessibility issues found: 73
  Errors: 52

  [Error] Application.AccessibleLabel: Missing accessible label
      Check: AccessibleLabelNeeded
      Why: If there's no accessible text, people who can’t see the screen won't understand what’s in images and controls.
      Fix: Edit the accessible label property to describe the item.
  [Error] Application_DataCardk.FocusedBorderThickness: Focus isn't showing
      Check: FocusBorderShouldBeVisible
      Why: If the focus isn't visible, people who don't use a mouse won't be able to see it when they're interacting with the app.
      Fix: Change the FocusedBorderThickness property to be more than 0.
  [Error] Application_DataCardk.TabIndex: Missing tab stop
      Check: TabIndexShouldBeDefinedForInteractiveControl
      Why: People who use the keyboard with your app will not be able to access this element without a tab stop.
      Fix: Set TabIndex to 0 or greater to ensure that interactive elements have a tab stop.
